reviews.title: AS2 Wave 7 runtime conformance for timeline, text, media, net and system APIs
reviews.summary: Promote 183 AS2 Target declarations implemented and verified in the ActionScript runtime and execute.mjs (_soundbuftime, getSWFVersion, getURL, loadVariables/Num, _level, load/unloadMovieNum, showRedrawRegions, TextField FlashType & TextRenderer, NetConnection/NetStream, Camera/Microphone, FileReference/List, System.capabilities, SharedObject, print); keep 34 OS/socket/IME entries partial.
